page.layout: One printed page (right-hand page of an opening), one column of running text; a narrow strip of the facing left page with marginal fragments at the left edge, which is cut off and unreadable, so not transcribed. Running head at top, page number at top right.

main_text.p: [illegible, ~10 letters]ihil abesse potest: hic aptus undi-que, perfectus, expletus est omni-um numeris: Quod ad ornatum & harmoniam ejus facit, nisi sensus ad ravim usque recla-mnet, extemplo concedendum est: Hoc in Philosophiæ funda-mento reponunt, hoc velut iusiurandum, quo Mangoni se obstringunt, non Philoso-phi jam, sed Philomangones. Aliquot fraudes tuas, o Man-go, proferemus in medium, quibus devotum istum gre-gem deludis: omnes profe-qui, voluminis opus erat. Tu eos tot ambientium inter se, & aliarum alias implicantium Sphærarum capsis inclusisti, ut spes nulla suppetat expe-dien-

page.notes: The left-page strip contains cut-off marginal and running text fragments that are not legible; omitted. Last line "dien-" continues on the next page. Some first-line letters are damaged by the binding shadow.
